text.tspan: The bench shall bind controlled source E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3/Add.151/Rev.2, original SHA-256 dc9cc84498dcae8f0888067ad3967fb5a346e814bc2f19128987a654c8a193de, source metadata, criterion map, evaluator identity, and an explicit applicability disposition.

For the pedestrian scenario only, the bench shall preserve the selected pedestrian-target criterion provenance, units, prescribed conditions, tolerance, uncertainty treatment, repeated-run rule, and tested configuration without making an authority interpretation.

For the bicycle scenario only, the bench shall preserve the selected bicycle-target criterion provenance, units, prescribed conditions, tolerance, uncertainty treatment, repeated-run rule, and tested configuration without making an authority interpretation.
The bench shall trace each bounded result to replayable observations, processing steps, unit conversion, next-higher-speed selection, repeated-run evidence, and boundary decision.
The bench shall hash-bind source metadata, criterion mapping, tested configuration, runtime, evaluator, measurements, and retained artifacts.

The bench shall limit the verdict to one exact tested configuration. Missing applicability, prescribed conditions, target fidelity, uncertainty, repetitions, source control, or provenance shall be inconclusive or error. Compliance, certification, homologation, and type approval remain withheld.
Reviewer question: What physical hardware, software, and mechanical
elements make up the candidate system, and in which internal roles
Evidence-based assurance claims and their supporting argumentation.
Reviewers need claims, arguments, evidence, and gaps linked
in an assurance argument for the increment.
